purpose: Evolve worker production by testing controlled stage-level changes on the same synthetic objective instead of changing the whole worker or inferring quality from raw launch count.
design_law: Change one behavioral stage rule per variant; keep objective, hard gates, authority and evidence rules constant.
Use two independent replicas per variant in the exploration round so one lucky/unlucky worker does not determine direction.
Do not automatically promote a variant from n=2. Select at most two candidates, then reproduce the candidate law on >=3 independent confirmation workers.
Primary comparison is hard-gate/product completion and autonomous reallocation. Speed/waste are tie-break diagnostics, not substitutes for completion.
A failed variant may reveal a useful component; never copy a whole persona or historical worker identity.

Candidate selection must align with the observed first failing pipeline stage; if the weak stage is not covered by the current variants, run a bounded stage-specific follow-up instead of promoting an unrelated winner.

variants.rule: After capsule load, execute directly against the acceptance contract using normal worker behavior.

Before any context beyond the packet header, form a six-field internal lock: objective, deliverables, hard gates, first durable action, forbidden shortcuts, terminal condition. Then proceed immediately.
Build a bounded backward plan from every hard gate to the concrete edits/tests required; execute in dependency order. No prose plan beyond the compact action map.
Before implementation, map each required feature/hard gate to the exact evidence that will prove it; use that map as the implementation checklist and close only when every row is PASS/BOUNDARY.
After first implementation, run a separate acceptance pass from the original packet with no reliance on the implementation summary; repair all found misses before RETURN.

promotion.promote_target: stage-specific law in WORKER-PIPELINE-V1/wc, not a worker persona
promotion.rollback: Any promoted law causing authority regression, lower hard-gate completion or material overhead regression is removed.

diagnostic_gate.purpose: Prevent exploration from promoting a locally attractive rule that does not address the stage actually limiting end-to-end worker yield.
diagnostic_gate.comparison_population: For E0-E2, use all RUN launch beacons plus durable primary-claim evidence so a beaconed worker that never claims a slot remains visible as a pre-variant stage outcome. For E3-E9, use stage_trace from benchmark receipts of assigned workers. Never attribute an unassigned launch to the evolution_variant of the slot that happened to remain open.
diagnostic_gate.candidate_stage_alignment: A variant may enter P2B only if (a) its changed_stage matches a repeated observed weak stage, or (b) it materially improves primary hard-gate completion/reallocation versus V0 without causing an earlier new failure stage. Speed/score alone never qualifies.
diagnostic_gate.repeated_failure_threshold: At least 2 independent workers reaching the same first non-PASS stage is enough to flag an exploration-stage weakness; this is a routing signal, not proof of a winning law.
diagnostic_gate.uncovered_stage_rule: If a repeated first failure emerges at E3_CONTEXT, E5_PRODUCE, E7_RETURN, E8_REALLOCATE, E9_EXAM_CLOSE, or another stage not directly targeted by a current intervention, do not promote an unrelated current variant. Arm one bounded follow-up variant that changes only that uncovered stage, then require the normal >=3 independent confirmation gate before baseline promotion.
diagnostic_gate.control_boundary: V0 has n=2 in exploration and is descriptive only. No causal claim or baseline promotion may be made from two control replicas alone.
diagnostic_gate.no_proxy_winner: Higher speed, lower context reads, higher word/token efficiency, or a better global productivity score cannot override lower primary completion, weaker evidence, or failed reallocation.
diagnostic_gate.prevariant_accounting: E0-E2 failures before slot ownership are run-level platform evidence, not variant evidence. Preserve them in the first-failure distribution and repair repeated platform loss before claiming variant causality.
